name: ai-starter-kits
description: StarterKit Radar — a static dashboard for comparing AI starter kits: scored on time-to-hello-world, stack coverage, difficulty, maturity, docs quality and cost. Metrics auto-refresh weekly from the GitHub API.

paragraphs: A static, frontend-only dashboard that helps developers choose between AI starter kits, templates and reference applications. Instead of a flat link list, every kit is scored on the things that actually stall a project: time to a working hello world, stack coverage, difficulty, maturity, documentation quality, licence and total cost of ownership.
Filter and sort the catalog, build a side-by-side comparison of up to four kits, and keep a persistent shortlist.
kits ready in ≤ 15 minutes, kits that run fully local, beginner-friendly kits, and the average readiness score.
features: Six live summary statistics computed from the catalog: total kits, categories covered,
